problem: a,b,c = construct_risos(), d = construct_on_circum(c,a,b), e = construct_parallelogram(a,b,d)
proof:
Solution:
1. Parallelogram(a,b,d,e) => Parallel(a,b,d,e) & Angle_a_b_d - Angle_a_e_d
2. Perpendicular(a,b,a,c) & Parallel(a,b,d,e) => Perpendicular(a,c,d,e)
3. Perpendicular(a,c,d,e) => Angle_a_c_d + Angle_c_d_e - pi/2
4. Concyclic(a,b,c,d) => Angle_a_b_d - Angle_a_c_d
5. Angle_a_b_d - Angle_a_e_d & Angle_a_c_d + Angle_c_d_e - pi/2 & Angle_a_b_d - Angle_a_c_d & Angle_c_d_e + Angle_c_e_d + Angle_d_c_e - pi & Angle_a_e_c + Angle_a_e_d - Angle_c_e_d => Angle_a_e_c + Angle_d_c_e - pi/2
6. Angle_a_e_c + Angle_d_c_e - pi/2 => Perpendicular(a,e,c,d)
7. Perpendicular(a,c,d,e) & Perpendicular(a,e,c,d) => Orthocenter(a,c,d,e)
8. Orthocenter(a,c,d,e) => Perpendicular(a,d,c,e)
